thread:
lena: heads up, deploying the mono example to Cloudflare Workers edge and the bundle fails to resolve our JS SDK when pnpm workspace layout is used. works in node but edge build stops.

omar: what error do you see?

lena: build output: 
```
Error: Failed to resolve module: '/workspace/node_modules/@redwood/sdk'
Caused by: Could not read package.json for '@redwood/sdk'
```

pri: yeah this smells like pnpm's .pnpm symlink directory. many edge builders expect a plain node_modules layout to read package.json.exports.

omar: quick experiments that usually help: 1) add "module": "dist/index.mjs" to the SDK package.json so esbuild can pick a file entry, 2) add explicit "types": "dist/index.d.ts" so TS resolves types, 3) for Next/Cloudflare use a Vite/rollup alias to the dist file.

lena: tried module+types, improved runtime but LSP still couldn't find types in the monorepo workspace.

pri: LSP in monorepos often reads types via the workspace resolution. if you want a minimal fix for the example, add a tiny packages/sdk-shim with a normal package.json (name: @acme/sdk-shim, module: dist/index.mjs, types: dist/index.d.ts) that simply re-exports the built files. then make apps depend on that shim.

omar: alternative .npmrc change: set public-hoist-pattern=@redwood/* so the package gets hoisted to top-level node_modules. Pros: builders find package.json. Cons: affects other hoisting.

lena: for the Edge sample I'm going to add an alias in the app's build config to point at the dist file and include a short note in the README about pnpm pitfalls. will also open an SDK issue to add module + types fields by default.

build-bot: Created task DOCS-321: "pnpm workspace + edge runtimes: sample + troubleshooting" (assignee: pri)

omar: also document recommended pnpm version and a minimal repro path (exact .pnpm path) so people can grep.

lena: noted. I'll push the sample PR with the alias and README today and reference DOCS-321. thanks! :shipit!
